title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Number of Plans a Customer May Hold
content:
# Number of Plans a Customer May Hold

**Plan terms, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.**

1. A customer may hold any number of line protection plans, for one or several properties.
2. There is no maximum number of Utility Line Protection Plans per customer.
3. Which plans one property may hold together is governed by the rule against overlapping lines on one property.

## Points of application

- A customer with plans on two different properties holds both; the count of plans a customer holds never by itself stops an enrollment.
- The limit that does exist concerns one property and the lines its plans cover, not the customer's total number of plans.

| Question | Answer under these terms |
|---|---|
| Is there a cap on how many line protection plans one customer holds? | No; any number may be held. |
| May the plans be on different properties? | Yes; for one or several properties. |
| Does this term decide which plans may sit together on one property? | No; that is governed by the rule against overlapping lines. |
